title: Sana from Workday Named a 2026 Top HR Product of the Year by HR Executive
summary: Sana Helps Employees Find Answers, Take Action, and Automate Work
body_markdown:
*Sana Helps Employees Find Answers, Take Action, and Automate Work*


**PLEASANTON, Calif., Sept. 15, 2026** --[Workday, Inc.](http://www.workday.com/) (NASDAQ: WDAY), the enterprise AI platform for HR, finance, and IT, today announced that[Sana from Workday](https://www.workday.com/en-us/artificial-intelligence/workday-sana.html) has been named a 2026 Top HR Product of the Year by HR Executive. The recognition honors Sana for helping organizations bring trusted AI into HR, so employees, managers, and HR teams can find answers, take action, and get work done more easily.


“For AI to transform HR, it has to understand the context, rules, and workflows that keep businesses running,” said Joel Hellermark, chief AI officer, Workday. “Sana brings that intelligence into one simple experience, helping employees find answers and take action while enabling organizations to automate HR work in a trusted, governed way.”


Employees often lose time searching across systems, policies, and knowledge sources to get simple answers or complete routine tasks. HR teams carry the other side of that burden, fielding repetitive requests that take time away from more strategic work. Sana helps address both challenges through one AI experience where employees can ask questions in plain language, get cited answers, take action, and automate everyday HR and finance workflows that normally take hours of manual effort and cause frustration.


Sana connects AI to the data, security, permissions, business processes, and controls organizations already rely on. Through Sana, employees can access more than 300 self-service skills across areas such as pay, time, and absence simply by asking a question or requesting an action. Sana orchestrates the right Workday agents behind the scenes, helping reduce routine service requests while giving HR teams more time for higher-value work. Sana also extends beyond Workday, helping employees find information and coordinate work across the systems they already use like Gmail, Slack, and Salesforce.


Hosted by HR Executive and HR Tech, the annual Top HR Products competition aims to uncover the most impactful and forward-thinking technologies introduced into the market over the last year. Each submission is reviewed by a panel of esteemed judges and then assessed for innovation, functionality, ease of use and value to HR organizations. After a rigorous evaluation and live product demonstration, Sana from Workday was recognized as a Top HR Product of 2026.


Workday will be honored on Monday, Oct. 19, during the HR Icons Awards Evening at Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas, the night before HR Tech 2026. Attendees can see Sana from Workday in action by visiting Workday at booth #4312 during expo hours from Tuesday, Oct. 20 to Thursday, Oct. 22.
